subject: Redwood security review: technical roundtable coordination
messages:
From: Ciara Nolan <ciara.nolan@stratusai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Peters <procurement@stratusai.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@stratusai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood security review: request to set up technical roundtable

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Stratus engineering + security leadership team wants to do a focused technical roundtable with Redwood security and our procurement team to get comfortable on controls and collection flows before we proceed to procurement.

Would you and someone from your security/compliance org be available for a 60–75 minute session next week? We want the following folks on the call:
- Ciara Nolan (me) — Sr. Security Engineer
- Evan Cho — CISO (brief intro only)
- Jordan Peters — Procurement
- 2x backend engineers (TBD)

Agenda we had in mind:
1) Data flows and tenancy model (VPC/private deploy options)
2) Key management and encryption-at-rest/in-transit
3) Audit logs, retention, and access controls
4) SOC2 artifacts and attestation questions

I attached our security questionnaire (Stratus_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf) so you can see the upfront asks. Can you propose 3 time slots in Pacific / Eastern windows that work for Redwood security + your AE/SE? We try to avoid Friday afternoons.

Thanks — Ciara

--
Ciara Nolan
Sr. Security Engineer, StratusAI
ciara.nolan@stratusai.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Ciara Nolan <ciara.nolan@stratusai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Peters <procurement@stratusai.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@stratusai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood security review: request to set up technical roundtable

Ciara — thanks for the clear brief and the questionnaire. Looping in Monica (SE) and Marissa (Security) from our side. Monica will cover deployment/topology and Marissa will handle controls + SOC2 artifacts. Rishi from procurement is CC'ed for contractual/PO questions.

Proposed 60–75m slots (all PT) — pick one and we’ll send a calendar invite that includes dial-in and a shared Drive folder with prep docs:
- Wed 2028-06-14 10:00–11:15 PT (1:00–2:15 ET)
- Thu 2028-06-15 13:00–14:15 PT (4:00–5:15 ET)
- Mon 2028-06-19 09:00–10:15 PT (12:00–1:15 ET)

Pre-read / prep from our side: Redwood-Security-Prep-Checklist.pdf (attached, short checklist), SOC2-Readout-Excerpt.pdf (redacted SOC2 summary). On the call we'll aim to:
- Walk the data flow diagram and which control plane data leaves customer VPC (if any)
- Confirm key management options (KMS/HSM partners) and where customer-managed keys fit
- Share our audit log schema and retention controls
- Answer questionnaire gaps live and note any follow-ups

If those times don't work, share a preferred window and we will try to accommodate.

Best,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ciara Nolan <ciara.nolan@stratusai.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood security review: request to set up technical roundtable

Hi Ciara — happy to join. Quick availability update from my side: I can do Wed 6/14 10:00 PT or Thu 6/15 13:00 PT. Prefer Wed morning.

A couple asks to make the session efficient:
- Please send two engineer attendees (names + high-level areas: infra/backend) so we can triage questions to the right SME.
- If you have red-team or SRE-specific questions that require longer logs or historical traces, flag them up front and we will schedule a follow-up deep dive.

I'll bring a short one-page control mapping to SOC2 and our standard network diagram.

-Marissa
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Alex / team — we can make Thu 6/15 13:00 PT work on our end. Also: two procurement items to confirm before invite is finalized:
1) Can Redwood provide a one-pager on data residency options and whether logs have cross-region replication enabled by default?
2) Any standard contract language for retention/FBAR/data deletion we should expect (we're prepping our legal team).

If you can drop the one-pager in the Drive link Alex mentioned that would be great.

Jordan

Alex / team — confirmed: Thu 2028-06-15 13:00 PT works for Stratus. Attendees from our side: myself (Ciara), Evan Cho (CISO, first 15m), Jordan Peters (procurement), plus backend engineers Priya Singh (infra) and Mateo Duarte (service reliability).

Two quick items prior to the call:
- We would like a short (10m) explanation of how Redwood isolates KV caches across tenants — that's Caller-facing and SSO-specific.
- Please upload the SOC2 excerpt and data residency one-pager to the shared Drive by EOD Monday so our legal/security can scan.

Thanks, looking forward to the sync.
